summary: Local activities executed concurrently with `asyncio.gather` cause non-determinism during replay because they complete in wall-clock time order during execution but sequence number order during replay, producing different command sequences.
userImpact: Workflows using concurrent local activities fail during replay with NondeterminismError, breaking workflow execution in production.
rootCause: Local activity completions are ordered by wall-clock time during execution but by sequence number during replay, causing different coroutine scheduling and command sequence assignments.
proposedFix: Ensure local activity completions are ordered consistently by sequence number during both execution and replay, regardless of wall-clock timing.
keyQuote: During first execution, local activity resolve_activity jobs arrive in completion order (wall-clock timing). During replay, they arrive in sequence number order.
